places.frame: site local training frame (EPSG:25832 translation in site metadata); GT = GTJUDGE addendum11 final_data reference__* (point_id indexes GTJUDGE rows.npz)

visible_wall.points: GT wall rows (reference__wall) inside the zone-2 box polygon with |normal_xy . wall_normal_out_xy| > 0.9
visible_wall.ground_z: TRAINLOG case scope ground_z -43.12701416015625 (height = z - ground_z)
visible_wall.control: the same zone's corner side wall: GT wall rows inside the zone-2 box with |normal_xy . out| < 0.3, height 0-10 m

south_wall.rule: addendum1.json places.south_wall: GT wall rows with along 0.7-19.3 m, z -43.3 to -25.0, |d| <= 1 m (wall face)
south_wall.control: long_wall (addendum1 rule, fitted face shift), the same |d| <= 1 m, out = +e

edge_band.rule: c1 (B0 x LoD2, case 2, completeness) lost points of the record run (sets_tl/c1_own_lost) inside addendum1 places back_wall_bottom and annex_roof_edge, two places
edge_band.control: sets_tl/c1_own_control points inside the same place mask; when fewer than 50, all c1 own control points inside the record region (voxel lookup)

floor_band.rule: sets_tl/c2_own_lost (R1rep x ALS, case 2, completeness) of the record run
floor_band.control: sets_tl/c2_own_control points inside the record region (voxel lookup)

places.work_da_sets: the original-run sets (sets/c1_own_lost in the two edge places, sets/c2_own_lost) because the target maps are the FINALTRAIN maps

edge_floater.rule: uncut mesh final.ply (before the building-scope cut): face centre planar distance outside the LoD2 footprint 0 < de <= 3 m, height above the scope ground >= 12 m, distance to GT dense > 1 m
edge_floater.footprint: TRAINLOG scope footprint of the site (B173: TRAINLOG config; B0: case config)
edge_floater.off_gt_building: faces within the render box of the building scope (inside the footprint buffer 1 m) farther than 1 m from GT dense: area

common.column_patch: GT point -> GTJUDGE rows row_owner -> JUDGEAPPLY core_points source_index -> target row; sets_tl patch_row; Gaussian target_index = index into the valid target rows (valid_patch order)
common.target_plane: patch anchor (targets 'target'), patch normal, sigma of the column patch
common.outward_normal: walls of visible/south/long wall: the place out direction; other walls (|n_z| < 0.5): sign making p + 0.5 n outside and p - 0.5 n inside the LoD2 prior solid (open3d occupancy), else the stored patch normal; non-walls: n_z > 0 (floor/roof front = up)
common.area: GT area of a place = occupied 0.25 m voxels of its GT points x 0.0625 m2
common.front_back: a Gaussian belongs to the place surface when its centre lies within 0.5 m tangentially of a place GT point (tangent distance in that point's target plane); s = (x - anchor).n_out of that point's column patch; front 0.2 < s <= 3 m, back -3 <= s < -0.2 m; counts and opacity sums by constraint state (same patch = bound to a place patch, other patch, released, background)
common.events: between consecutive saved states by seq (seq_prev, seq_cur]: delete rows with tag 1 and target_index in the place patches by reason (1 opacity, 2 world size, 3 screen size, 4 other, 5 split parent); release with previous_target_index in the place patches; retarget out (old in, new out) and in; births = Gaussians of the later state bound to the place patches with born_at in (it_prev, it_cur]. Events exist only for Gaussians inside the record range at the last range check (TRAINLOG: buffered footprint x [z_min, z_max]; TRAINERR: voxel region)
common.completeness: GTJUDGE rule: share of place GT points with |row_s| <= row_tau_m on the mesh of that iteration (stored score distances, or te_mesh score points.npz)

tl_B0_b10_LoD2_s0.states: TRAINLOG scene/*.pt (all Gaussians, 65 states incl. 4 pre_reset)
tl_B0_b10_LoD2_s0.meshes: TRAINLOG case meshes tl_<n> + the four added meshes

tl_B0_LoD2_own.states: TRAINERR trainlog/states/*.npz (Gaussians inside the voxel region, 65 states incl. 4 pre_reset)

work_ga.time_points: every saved state; <it>_pre_reset and <it> counted separately

added_meshes.rule: scene .pt -> ply (TRAINLOG lineage_key ply rule) -> GTJUDGE mesh_job render/prepare/plan/tile/merge/finish + te_mesh score, the record run's view list

work_ga.section: vertical plane through the place GT centroid; walls: across the wall (in-plane horizontal axis = out); bands: across the minor principal XY axis of the place points; thickness +-0.25 m; Gaussian centres coloured by state, size by opacity; GT grey, target plane blue, mesh red where a mesh exists

code_check: the rule choosing which patch target is written to a pixel (occlusion: prior faces only, image depth, outside the unit box)
a rule comparing image depth and target depth that removes or down-weights a target (condition, threshold) or none
image 0013 south-wall pixels through those rules
correction 1: depth-loss rendered depth formula (divided by the weight sum or not), opacity gradient, where the depth weight and pixel weight multiply
work_da.arm: own (본 방법 판정; FINALTRAIN maps) only - the closest single definition (order 1.5)
work_da.pixel_classes: addendum2: front = image depth < target - 1 m, behind = image depth > target + 1 m (image depth finite, > 0 and conf > 0)
work_da.diff: front: target - image depth; behind: image depth - target

place_patch_sets.edge_band: column patches of sets/c1_own_lost inside back_wall_bottom / annex_roof_edge
place_patch_sets.south_wall: addendum2 wall_zone_patches south (valid patches, centre in the zone, |d| <= 1 m)
place_patch_sets.visible_wall: column patches of the visible-wall GT points (0-10 m)
place_patch_sets.fixed_by_judgment: column patches of addendum2 work-ra points (own) in group 'fixed' of case 1 (사전정보 오류), split by their patch judgment 보존 / 일치 / 보정
place_patch_sets.kept_by_scene: column patches of addendum2 work-ra points (own) in group 'kept', per scene

work_da.patch_stat: per patch with >= 1 front (behind) pixel: share of its front (behind) pixels whose diff exceeds the threshold; per place set: median, p10, p90 over patches
work_da.consistency: per patch: views with >= 1 front pixel; std over views of the per-view median diff (views with >= 5 front pixels)
work_da.gradient: correction 1: R1 floor band and its control: |d photo / d opacity logit| and |d depth / d opacity logit| of Gaussians bound to the place patches from the record-run grads/*.npz (uid join to states) at every gradient iteration; median and sum per place

work_na.pixels: pixels whose target owner is a south-wall patch (addendum2 wall_zone_patches south); classes front / same / no image depth (addendum2)
work_na.decomposition: 2DGS ray-splat intersection compositing re-implemented in torch with the same camera and the inherited rasterizer rules (per-pixel sorted contributions w_i = alpha_i T_i, depth = ray-splat intersection depth); checked against the CUDA render (accumulated opacity and depth) at the same pixels
values: rendered depth = weighted mean (2DGS expected depth / accumulated opacity, depth_ratio 0)
depth where the cumulative weight reaches 0.5
weight per bin by constraint state

work_ma.scene: B173nb_b10__ALS, mesh = TRAINLOG tl_30000 uncut final.ply (the floater_check mesh)
work_ma.image_points: all finite > 0 MVS depth pixels of every training view before the confidence mask (s61 maps mvs), unprojected with the training camera
work_ma.control: faces of the same mesh within 0.2 m of GT dense, inside the footprint, same height range (>= 12 m)
work_ma.photos: two training views with camera centre east of the floater centroid and elevation 20-60 deg seen from the floater, most projected floater vertices inside the image (20 px margin); no occlusion test
work_ma.states: tl_B173nb_b10_ALS_s0 attempt2 scene/*.pt at the work-ga strip times: Gaussians within 0.5 m of edge-floater face centres: count, opacity, size, constraint state

variants.base: unchanged rule (rebuilt; compared with the stored mesh)
variants.opacity_0.5: pixels with accumulated opacity < 0.5 get no depth
variants.discontinuity_0.5: pixels whose rendered depth differs from any 4-neighbour by > 0.5 m get no depth
variants.median_depth: depth where the cumulative weight reaches 0.5 (2DGS median depth) instead of the weighted mean

values: scene completeness and accuracy, case values (addendum11 rule via te_mesh score)
annex box: result points farther than 1 m from GT (B0 ALS)
edge floater area, off-GT building area
south wall: share of result points behind the wall by more than 0.64 m, wall accuracy (B0 LoD2)
loss of right surface: GT points within tau on base, outside tau on the variant

ba1_B0_LoD2_nonormal.base: tl_B0_b10_LoD2_s0 command (TRAINLOG case config, trainlog on)

ba3_B0_ALS_record.base: FINALTRAIN ft_ALS_s0 B0 command + TRAINERR record options (trainlog on with /cfg/trainlog_te.json, voxel region = the annex box snapped outward to 0.25 m, gradients on)

ba4_B173_ALS_nojudge.status: stop condition of correction 1 checked before training; see issues.md

work_ba.gpu_rule: start on a GPU with >= 14 GiB free memory and at most one addendum-3 training per GPU; other jobs are never stopped
work_ba.report_with: ba1/ba2 scene values beside the record run and the original FINALTRAIN run
